# helm

Generated by the pinned `ess generate --kind docs` from [`adapters/kubernetes/spec/ess`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/kubernetes/spec/ess). Structural validation establishes consistency; behaviour, storage and cross-record predicates remain implementation obligations.

Kubernetes-owned release-storage coordinates, revision observations and redacted content projections.

`connectors_kubernetes.helm` is one of connectors_kubernetes's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `ManifestDocumentProjection`

`connectors_kubernetes.helm.ManifestDocumentProjection` is a record of four fields:

- `source_secret` — `String`
- `index` — `Integer`
- `bytes` — `Integer`
- `content_digest` — `String`

### `RecordedValueKind`

`connectors_kubernetes.helm.RecordedValueKind` is one of `object`, `array`, `string`, `number`, `boolean` and `null_value`.

### `RecordedValueProjection`

`connectors_kubernetes.helm.RecordedValueProjection` is a record of four fields:

- `source_secret` — `String`
- `path` — `String`
- `kind` — `connectors_kubernetes.helm.RecordedValueKind`
- `value_digest` — `String`

Every value satisfies `(path.count >= 1 and path.count <= 1024)`.

### `ReleaseCoordinates`

`connectors_kubernetes.helm.ReleaseCoordinates` is a record of two fields:

- `namespace` — `String`
- `release` — `String`

Every value satisfies `(release.count >= 1 and release.count <= 53)`.

### `ReleaseRevision`

`connectors_kubernetes.helm.ReleaseRevision` is a record of eight fields:

- `source_secret` — `String`
- `source_revision` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `namespace` — `String`
- `release` — `String`
- `revision` — `Integer`
- `status` — `connectors_kubernetes.helm.ReleaseStatus`
- `created_at_unix_s` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent
- `modified_at_unix_s` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent

Every value satisfies `(not (defined(source_revision)) or source_revision.count <= 512)`.

### `ReleaseStatus`

`connectors_kubernetes.helm.ReleaseStatus` is one of `unknown`, `deployed`, `uninstalled`, `superseded`, `failed`, `uninstalling`, `pending_install`, `pending_upgrade` and `pending_rollback`.

Four of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors_kubernetes.helm.ManifestDocumentProjection`, `connectors_kubernetes.helm.RecordedValueProjection`, `connectors_kubernetes.helm.ReleaseCoordinates` and `connectors_kubernetes.helm.ReleaseRevision`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
